newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Eletrobras share sale nets 199.15 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Eletrobras share sale nets 199.15 mln reais.

text.p: BNDESpar sold 400 million common shares in Brazilian state power firm Eletrobras plus the same amount of call options for 199.15 million reais ($187.9 million) on the Rio de Janeiro bourse, a stock exchange spokeswoman said.
BNDESpar, the investment arm of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES), hoped to raise at least 185 million reais ($174.5 million) with the sell-off.
The shares account for 0.88 percent of Eletrobras' voting capital and 0.74 percent of the firm's total capital.

Of the 24 financial institutions brokering the deal, Norsul acquired the largest block worth 36.2 million reais ($34.2 million), followed by Banco Omega with 35.6 million reais ($33.6 million) and Citibank with 20.9 million reais ($19.7 million).
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
